fusion_rules.rule: Validate that a requested browser, audit, or test tool is available and its invocation boundary is safe before setup.
Accept only: A tool request, project path, shell environment, and declared prerequisite contract.
Produce only: A prerequisite verdict, supported wrapper boundary, or explicit unavailable-tool failure.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.
